globalRules.provenance: Record source ID/version, original digest, owner, period, precise locator and excerpt. A digest proves byte identity, not truth.
globalRules.materiality: Assessor records decision relevance and materiality; no numeric thresholds until calibrated.
globalRules.primary: Primary source or genuinely equivalent evidence with documented human acceptance is required for material judgement. Supplementary evidence is selected according to claim; it is not automatically mandatory. Conditional evidence must be requested if trigger applies.
globalRules.independence: Distinct bytes or owners are only structural indicators; reviewer must confirm source independence, relevance, common basis and credibility.
globalRules.classification: E1 directly documented; E2 credible independent corroboration; E3 asserted; E4 unknown. Strength Strong/Moderate/Weak remains separate from class and condition.
globalRules.contradiction: Open material contradiction takes precedence over supported condition; preserve competing evidence and reasoned resolution with reviewer.
globalRules.sufficiency: Treat material missing or weak untested claim as insufficient; no automatic low score; distinguish supported adverse evidence from unknown.
globalRules.review: Reviewer separate from author, named rationale and precise citations; accept or return, never infer consent.
globalRules.scoring: Scoring eligibility remains locked for this draft; later approval and calibration required, N/A treatment and critical-risk thresholds unapproved.
globalRules.pilot: Only synthetic and explicitly authorised pilot inputs; no public deployment or client data in GitHub.
